apropos.sousTitre: FIRAS BKA CAR, your trusted partner in Tangier.

histoire.p1: Founded in Tangier, FIRAS BKA CAR was born from the desire to offer a quality vehicle rental service at fair prices. Our agency, located in the Branes 1 district (Rue 50, Tangier), has been serving customers for several years with professionalism and passion.
histoire.p2: Our fleet is carefully selected and regularly maintained to guarantee your safety and comfort on every journey.

items: Transparent prices with no hidden fees
Customer service available 7 days a week

faq.sousTitre: Find quick answers to your questions.

items.q: What documents do I need to rent a car?
items.a: You must present a valid driving licence, an identity document (national ID card or passport) and proof of address.
All our rentals include unlimited mileage. You can drive without worrying about the kilometres.
Yes, comprehensive insurance is included in every rental. You are covered in the event of damage.

items.q: Can I collect the vehicle at the airport?
items.a: Yes, we provide a shuttle service to and from Tangier Ibn Battouta Airport.
We accept cash, Visa, Mastercard and CMI payment. A 40% deposit is required at the time of booking.
